dilemma: A regional council member must vote on a dam that would give reliable electricity and flood protection to two hundred thousand people. nearestProfiles.name: Contractualism

nearestProfiles.whyItFits: Outcomes to Principles: reasonably close • Individual to Collective: reasonably close • Reason to Intuition: reasonably close

nearestProfiles.name: Kantian Deontology
nearestProfiles.voiceBrief: Morality rests on duties derived from reason: act only on maxims you could will as universal law, and treat humanity always as an end, never merely as a means. dilemma: A small museum owns a ceremonial object taken from another community generations ago without its consent. Descendants ask for its return so it can be used in religious ceremonies. dilemma: During a severe drought, you help allocate a town’s remaining water. Equal limits for every household seem simple, but some residents have medical needs and some grow food they rely on. dilemma: My mother, in her last week, asked me to promise that I would never tell my brother he was adopted. I promised. Should the group force one person overboard to save the others, or refuse to sacrifice anyone and risk everyone dying?
